_about: Operational service-quality categories used by Agent 1. They are ADAPTED from E-S-QUAL / E-RecS-QUAL (Parasuraman, Zeithaml & Malhotra, 2005) and e-GovQual (Papadomichelaki & Mentzas, 2012). Each category carries a PROVISIONAL crosswalk ('egsqual_candidate') to the seven EGSQUAL dimensions of Aljukhadar et al. (2022); see egsqual_reference.json for what has and has not been verified. 'examples_ar' are real reviews from the research dataset. The code reads keys, names, definitions and keywords from this file, so no code change is required to revise them.

EFFICIENCY.definition: The ease and speed with which beneficiaries can access the app, navigate it and complete a task with minimal effort (clear steps, intuitive interface, quick access).
example_issues: Too many steps to log in

examples_ar.text: تطبيق معقد مايراعي ثقافات الناس اللي تستخدمه ،، مليون الف برنامج عشان اخذ صوره 👎🏾👎🏾👎🏾
لا استطيع اختيار من القوائم نرجو حل المشكلة

SYSTEM_AVAILABILITY.definition: The correct technical functioning of the app: it opens, stays up, does not freeze or crash, authentication and verification codes work, and error messages do not prevent use.

examples_ar.text: لا أستطيع الدخول إلى التطبيق ولا يرسل رمز التفعيل
التطبيق دايما يعلق ويعمل خروج من الحساب بدون اي سبب

FULFILLMENT.definition: The extent to which the digital service is actually delivered as promised: transactions, payments, registrations and requests are completed accurately, and the expected service options exist.
FULFILLMENT.source: E-S-QUAL: Fulfillment; e-GovQual: Reliability (service delivered as promised)
example_issues: Fees paid but registration not completed

examples_ar.text: بعد التحديث لا يقبل اي طلب !!!!؟
التطبيق لا يظهر الفاتوره دوما هناك خلل به

PRIVACY_SECURITY.definition: The degree to which the app is safe and protects beneficiaries' personal and financial information, and beneficiaries trust it with their data.

examples_ar.text: بعد تحميل التطبيق تم تسريب بريدي الإلكتروني تصلني يوميا رسائل احتيال بوجود شحنة ومطلوب سداد مبلغ مالي

RESPONSIVENESS.definition: Effective handling of beneficiaries' problems, complaints and reports: timely responses, follow-up, and transparency about the outcome.
example_issues: No response from the complaints team

examples_ar.text: لا يوجد تجاوب مع الاسف هل هو خلل في البرنامج او تجاهل من القائم على التطبيق لا نعلم
للأسف الى الان لم يتم حل مشكلة اضافة الحجز.

CONTACT.definition: Availability of channels to reach the service provider (in-app support, phone, chat, complaint form) and the ability to talk to a person when needed.

examples_ar.text: محدود الخيارات في رفع الشكاوى على مشاكل شركات الاتصالات والشحن.

INFORMATION_QUALITY.definition: Accuracy, completeness, clarity and currency of the information and content shown in the app, including correct language/localisation and up-to-date data.

examples_ar.text: يعطي نتائج غير صحيحة و معلومات مظللة ينقصها الحد الادنى من العلم في كفاءة الاستهلاك.

UNMAPPED.definition: The feedback reports a problem, but the evidence does not show which aspect of the service failed, so no service-quality dimension can be assigned without guessing.
UNMAPPED.source: Prototype rule (not part of any published scale)
example_issues: 'The app does not work' with no feature or step named
